core_meaning.primary_meaning: Aadhil is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Just, fair, upright”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Aadhil corresponds to the Arabic form عادل (Arabic root ع د ل (ʿ-d-l); عَادِل (ʿĀdil)). Its core sense is just, fair, upright. Aadhil is Arabic عَادِل (ʿĀdil) 'just, fair, upright', from the root ع د ل (ʿ-d-l). The source gloss 'Close friend' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as aadil.

persian.name: عادل
persian.long_meaning: Aadhil (عادل) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن عادل، دادگر، درست است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: आदिल

pashto.name: عادل

arabic.name: عادل
